_readme: Relevance smoke fixture for the search-parity gate (T4-2). Each entry pairs an unambiguous query (an exact title/artist string, or its Korean rendering, from the committed corpus) with a STABLE KEY identifying the expected record: expectNumbers ({tj?/ky?/joysound?} — at least one vendor karaoke number, which is stable identity) plus expectTitle/expectArtist as a self-documenting cross-check. The harness (search-parity.golden.test.ts) resolves expectNumbers against the loaded corpus to the current record id at setup (failing loudly if a key hits zero or multiple records, or if the resolved title/artist have drifted), then asserts that id appears in the TOP 3 results of BOTH the client MiniSearch path and the worker SQLite path. Pinning by karaoke number (not the POSITIONAL blog-* id, which reshuffles whenever a crawl re-touches a blog page) removes the per-crawl manual re-pin toil. These are curated from real corpus records (verified, not guessed) so a ranking regression that buries an obvious match fails loudly on whichever path regressed. Consumed by search-parity.golden.test.ts; independent of the divergence snapshot.
